description:
Adopt charon 340b1af4 (0.1.232) + aeneas c10cc997 as the pinned proof toolchain, replacing the current 487f0320+local-patch / 5220259c pair. Spike 34d85cb9 (dev/active/34d85cb9/findings.md, Upgrade leg) built the pair and measured the breakage; this is a migration on the scale of issue 150d7d79, approved by the owner 2026-08-19.

## Background

The new pair regenerates `proofs/Gf2Core/Funs.lean` with 311 non-comment-line differences and aborts `scripts/fix-aeneas-gf2algebra.py` (Zip-instance assumption). The project-local Charon patch (preserved at dev/active/34d85cb9/upgrade/charon-local-patch-487f0320.patch) no longer applies and is subsumed upstream. The prebuilt pair lives under /data/aeneas-upgrade-34d85cb9.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `scripts/fix-aeneas-gf2algebra.py`, `fix-aeneas-dupes.py`, and `fix-aeneas-sorrys.py` run cleanly on the new pair's output, with repaired or retired assumptions.
- [hard] REQ-02: `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` regenerates the extraction and `(cd proofs && lake build)` passes with every hand-written proof re-verified against the regenerated Lean.
- [hard] REQ-03: The obsolete local-patch banner in `scripts/verify-lean.sh` is removed and the host installation is switched to the new pair (binary replacement requires the owner's approval at execution time).
- [hard] REQ-04: The F4 loop-binder defect (lifted loop functions drop associated-type binders; evidence in dev/active/34d85cb9/upgrade/excerpts/A8b_pow_loop_signature.txt) is reported upstream to AeneasVerif/aeneas with a minimal reproducer, and the report link is recorded here.

## Amendment — DEC-R (2026-08-23)

The upstream report additionally covers the Lean-backend duplicate
clause-field emission: Aeneas names a trait-clause record field from the
trait reference alone, so bounds on Self and on associated-type parameters
collide in one structure (record and root-cause reading:
dev/active/e6ea0dde/record.md, reproduced on the newest-upstream pair).
Added by owner decision DEC-R together with the sanctioning of the committed
fix-aeneas-dupes.py normalization for the FiniteFieldExt extraction class.
title: Migrate Charon/Aeneas toolchain to newest upstream
